Beautiful-Spacious Laurel Grove Cottage with Golf Cart & Free Activities

Your Luxury Escape at Sandestin Resort, Miramar Beach
Welcome to Your Dream Vacation Cottage!

Discover the perfect blend of comfort, luxury, and adventure at our charming 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom cottage in the coveted Laurel Grove community at Sandestin Resort, Miramar Beach, FL. Designed especially for families and vacation groups, this home offers a peaceful retreat just moments from the best the resort has to offer.

Special Offer: Save 10% on Extended Stays
Make your getaway even sweeter! Enjoy 10% off when you book a 7-night stay directly with us using coupon code 7nt10. This exclusive offer applies to new reservations only—some restrictions may apply. Book now to secure your discount and start planning your ultimate Sandestin escape!

Property Features
• Three Spacious Bedrooms.
• King Master Suite (Main Floor): Relax in the spacious master suite, featuring a luxurious king bed and a private ensuite bathroom for added comfort and privacy.
• King Guest Room (Main Floor): This inviting guest room offers a plush king bed and its own full bathroom, ensuring convenience for guests sharing the main level.
• Upstairs Bedroom (Second Floor): Perfect for families or groups, the upper-level bedroom is furnished with two queen beds and boasts a stylish ensuite bathroom.
• Wrap-Around Porch: Unwind with morning coffee or evening cocktails on the airy, wrap-around porch overlooking peaceful community views.
• Golf Cart Included: Zip around the resort in your own 6-person golf cart. Upgrade to add a 4-person cart for even more flexibility (additional fee applies).

Pet Policy
Traveling with a furry friend? We consider small, hypoallergenic dogs (with prior approval) to make your trip even more enjoyable. Please inquire for details.

Resort and Local Attractions
• Laurel Grove Clubhouse: Just steps away, this clubhouse features a large heated pool during winter holidays, shaded arbors, an adjoining hot tub, gas BBQ grill and restrooms for convenience.
• Phil Hummel SOA Pool: Enjoy year-round access to a heated pool, perfect for swimming in any season.
• Private Beach: The resort’s white sand beach is complemented by beachside restaurants, often hosting local live bands for a festive atmosphere.
• Baytowne Wharf Village: Only 1.5 miles away, this vibrant area boasts shopping, dining, and nightlife, offering entertainment for guests of all ages.
• Grand Boulevard Mall: Conveniently located nearby, the mall features grocery stores, retailers, restaurants, and boutiques. A lighted tunnel beneath the highway lets you walk, bike, or rollerblade across the resort with safety and ease.
• Championship Golf Courses: Four professional courses provide variety for golf enthusiasts—book tee times and enjoy lush greens and scenic fairways.
• World-Class Tennis Courts: Challenge friends or family or take lessons at the resort’s premier facilities.
• Nature Trails: Miles of walking, running, biking, and rollerblading trails wind through the resort, ideal for morning jogs or sunset strolls.

Unique Benefits
• Free activities included in your stay! Your stay includes over $700 of FREE activities every day of your stay. With the Memories Fun Pass, all eligible reservations receive one free ticket, every day of your stay, to the following attractions:
• Sea Blaster Daytime and Sunset Dolphin Cruises
• Day Passes to Big Kahuna's Water Park
• Party Fishing Trips
• Golf at Regatta Bay
• Golf at Emerald Bay
• Golf at Windswept Dunes
• Golf Simulation Studio
• Baytowne Adventure Zone
• Indoor Black Light Mini Golf

• Heated Pools: Both the neighborhood pool (seasonally) and Phil Hummel SOA pool (year-round) are heated, ensuring swimming is comfortable regardless of the season.
• Golf Cart Convenience: The included golf cart allows you to easily access the beach, shops, restaurants, and entertainment at Grand Boulevard or Baytowne Wharf, eliminating the need to drive and park.
• Resort Atmosphere: The Emerald Coast’s largest resorts are renowned for their stunning beaches, emerald green waters, and inviting ambiance—a perfect escape to unwind and rejuvenate.
• Year-Round Sunshine: Western Florida enjoys over 300 sunny days annually, with water temperatures ranging from high 80s in summer to mid-60s in winter, making vacationing enjoyable any time of year.
• Global Recognition: Frommer’s named the Florida Panhandle among the top ten most beautiful places in the world for 2010, affirming the area’s breathtaking beaches and natural charm.

Ready for the Ultimate Gulf Course Front Getaway?
Whether you’re traveling as a family, couple, or group, this gulf course front home offers unparalleled comfort, stunning views, and endless recreation in the heart of the Emerald Coast’s top-rated resort. Enjoy the convenience of free activities, resort amenities, and easy access to the area’s most celebrated beaches and attractions. Book today, claim your exclusive discount, and set the stage for a truly unforgettable escape—where every detail is designed for relaxation and lasting memories.

description: Located in Laurel Grove, a neighborhood in Miramar Beach, this vacation home is next to a golf course and near the beach. Shoppers can check out HarborWalk Village, while everyone can enjoy the natural beauty of Miramar Beach and Santa Rosa Beach. Big Kahuna's Water and Adventure Park and Blast Arcade and Laser Maze are also worth visiting. Surfing/body boarding, fishing, and swimming offer great chances to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with cycling nearby.
